question: Which of the following schemes was launched for the welfare of the unorganised sector workers and labourers on 26 August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**e-Shram Portal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **e-Shram Portal** was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment on **26 August 2021**.
 
• This portal aims to **create a National Database of Unorganized Workers (NDUW)** to ensure their welfare and social security.
 
• It provides a unique identification number called **Universal Account Number (UAN)** to each worker.
 
• The registration on the portal is free of cost and is expected to benefit around **38 crore unorganized workers** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PM Mentoring Yuva Scheme**

 
 
• This scheme is aimed at mentoring young authors below the age of 30.
 
• The goal is to create a pool of authors who can write on a variety of subjects to promote the Indian culture and literature globally.
 
 
 
• **PM Daksh Yojana**
 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to provide skill training to marginalized groups.
 
• The aim is to enhance the competency levels of marginalized communities and improve their employability.
 
 
 
• **Gram Ujala Scheme**
 
 
• Launched by Convergence Energy Services Limited (CESL) to provide affordable LED bulbs in rural areas.
 
• The scheme aims to promote energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions.
